schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Lake Oroville (Region 2, Butte Co.) for fingerling-size Chinook Salmon under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of April-June. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
